null_means: not established by the reviewed sources, not zero
scope: UMass Amherst, not other UMass campuses

tool.name: UCard meal transactions / CBORD GET
tool.ecosystem_role: Meal-plan balance and usage records; candidate demand signal

current_use_evidence.evidence: UMass FAQ links meal-plan balances and usage to get.cbord.com/umass.

tool.assumption_for_the_build: Use anonymized time-binned admission counts supplied by Dining. Treat timestamp resolution, location coverage and all-entry coverage as requirements to verify.
limitations: GET access for students does not prove a public bulk API or administrator export.
Meal transactions are not dish choices.
Repeat entries are not unique students; admissions are not simultaneous occupancy.
Cash, credit, guests and retail transactions may be represented differently.
No individual student identifiers are required for the proposed forecasting layer.
No swipe-system-specific waste-reduction effect was found.
